data.title: Garden Centre and Florist
data.summary: A modern retail horticulture library: glasshouse bays, benching, Danish trolleys, irrigation and potting kit, empty pots and bagged compost, a florist workroom, tills and an outdoor hard landscaping yard.
data.description: A realistic modern garden centre and florist fixture library in metre units: modular aluminium glasshouse bays with gables, a door bay, a lobby, partitions, ridge vents and gutter runs, plus polytunnel hoops and a canopy walkway; rolling and fixed benching on a 1.8 m grid, tiered display stands, Danish trolleys with real castors, pot rings and crate stacks; irrigation booms, misting lines, hose points, propagators, potting benches and compost bulk bays; retail merchandise from nested terracotta and glazed pot stacks to seed racks, tool bays, watering cans, plant feed and sagging banded compost pallets; a florist workroom with a glass door chiller, bucket stands, wrapping and wire benches, wreath frames and a conditioning sink; till counters with a named cash drawer, trolley bays, wheelbarrows and garden furniture displays; and an outdoor yard of paving, aggregate, sleepers, fence and trellis racks, a water feature and cold frames. Named pivots on the glasshouse door, lobby leaves, ridge vent, tunnel door, sales gate, chiller doors, till drawer, propagator lid and cold frame lid. No living plants are modelled anywhere in this pack. Static CC0 geometry prepared for human review.

starterScene.title: Glasshouse retail bay (Garden Centre and Florist)
starterScene.summary: A four bay retail glasshouse on the 2 m bay grid standing behind its sales floor: a gable end, two plain bays, the customer door bay and a closing gable, with an irrigation boom on its gantry inside the house, a run of fixed and rolling benching and a potting bench in front...
starterScene.description: A four bay retail glasshouse on the 2 m bay grid standing behind its sales floor: a gable end, two plain bays, the customer door bay and a closing gable, with an irrigation boom on its gantry inside the house, a run of fixed and rolling benching and a potting bench in front of it, two Danish trolleys, pot, crate and basket displays, a tiered stand and the till counter, corner, queue guide and trolley at the exit. No plants are modelled: the pots, baskets and benches are empty, which is why the floor reads sparse. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data.
